# Brain index

The map of what this operation knows and where each piece of it lives.
Curated pages hold knowledge that has no other home. Generated registries
are rebuilt from the files that already own the facts, so the index can go
stale but it cannot go wrong: `python3 workflow/brain.py check` fails the
build when it drifts.
